title: kbmon's bench panel shows a paid run's progress, spend against its cap and sandbox disk
goal: a bench panel reads progress.json and results.jsonl in _cache/bench-multi of the main worktree of the clone --root names and the size of its agents' sandbox directories, and shows run N of M per arm, the spend against the cap in dollars, the sandbox disk and whether its pid still runs, with no path outside the clone; with no run it is absent

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
T=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp());S=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['BENCH_SCRATCH']=S
s.run(['git','init','-q',T],check=True)
D=os.path.join(T,'_cache','bench-multi');os.makedirs(D)
json.dump({'agents':[{'n':1},{'n':2},{'n':3}],'bare':True},open(os.path.join(D,'sandbox.json'),'w'))
json.dump({'pid':os.getpid(),'started':'2026-10-19T07:00:00Z','planned':{'kb':3,'bare':3},'done':{'kb':2,'bare':1},'spend_usd':3.5,'max_usd':10.0},open(os.path.join(D,'progress.json'),'w'))
open(os.path.join(D,'results.jsonl'),'w').write(''.join(json.dumps(x)+'\n' for x in [{'arm':'kb','cost':1.5},{'arm':'kb','cost':1.5},{'arm':'bare','cost':0.5}]))
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_multi
sb=bench_multi.clone_path(D,1);os.makedirs(sb);open(os.path.join(sb,'f'),'wb').write(b'0'*2000000)
e=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='160');ok=False
try:
    q=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','bench','--root',T],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=e);j=q.stdout
    if q.returncode not in (0,1):print('kbmon exit',q.returncode,q.stderr.strip()[-200:]);sys.exit(1)
    t=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--once','--panel','bench','--root',T],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=e).stdout
    print(t)
    d=json.loads(j)['panels']['bench']
    ok=(d['state']=='ok' and (d['data'].get('sandbox_bytes') or 0)>=2000000 and '2/3' in t and '1/3' in t and '3.50' in t and '10.00' in t and T not in t and S not in t)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(T,ignore_errors=True);shutil.rmtree(S,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: a bench panel reads progress.json and results.jsonl in _cache/bench-multi of the main worktree of the clone --root names and the size of its agents' sandbox directories
shows run N of M per arm, the spend against the cap in dollars, the sandbox disk and whether its pid still runs, with no path outside the clone
with no run it is absent

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19: make kbmon readable and useful for a human operator (summaries of what sessions do); the orchestrator's notes from watching the night run of 2026-10-19 with kbmon. Premise on origin/main 9cee34c, 2026-10-19: kbmon has no bench panel (--panel bench exits 2); the paid run's progress was invisible during the 2026-10-19 night run.
